ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  BSE Limited reported exceptionally strong financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with consolidated revenue from operations increasing substantially to ₹1,56,602 lakhs and net profit after tax reaching ₹87,266 lakhs, demonstrating robust year-over-year and sequential growth. The Board also approved the appointment of M/s KKC & Associates LLP as statutory auditors and a strategic increase in its direct stake in India International Bullion Holding IFSC Limited (IIBH) from 3.33% to 20%, consolidating ownership previously held by its subsidiaries. This acquisition makes IIBH a direct associate company of BSE Limited, with no material red flags noted in the limited financial review.
